quarterly_data.quarter: Caterpillar press release: Caterpillar Invests in North Carolina's Future (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Caterpillar recently announced plans to invest approximately $1 billion in North Carolina to expand manufacturing capacity for products that support its growing Cat Compact business (compact equipment for small contractors and growing businesses); the investment includes plans for a new manufacturing facility in Sanford designed to increase production of compact track loaders and telehandlers to meet customer demand. Caterpillar's Clayton, North Carolina facility manufactures small wheel loaders and supports the distribution of backhoe loaders. Caterpillar employs more than 3,600 people in North Carolina and works with 325 suppliers across the state.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately $1 billion North Carolina investment; more than 3,600 employees and 325 suppliers in North Carolina
